text: The Patriots cruised to a dominant 20-3 victory over the Steelers at Gillette Stadium, with the defense putting on a masterclass in man coverage while TreVeyon Henderson punched in a touchdown, though the film breakdown on Drake Maye's performance revealed a quarterback still learning the balance between patience and aggression that New England seeks from him. The win came at a cost, however, as starting right guard Mike Onwenu suffered a broken right ankle that will sideline the offensive lineman going forward, one of several injuries the Patriots picked up in the hard-fought home opener. Head Coach Mike Vrabel's team became the first of the original AFL franchises to reach 600 wins, a milestone that underscores the organization's sustained excellence even as it navigates questions about offensive consistency after last season's Super Bowl run. The bright spot remains that elite defensive performance in man coverage, which suggests that when the offense eventually finds its rhythm, this team will have built a foundation capable of sustaining another deep playoff run.
